headline_seed: Houthis move to seize strategic terrain after Trump calls off airstrikes at last minute - The Guardian
draft_text:
Houthi forces have seized Yemen's Red Sea coast and sit adjacent to Bab al-Mandab, a strait linking the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden. The UN says 125,000 people have been displaced since September. CNN and The Guardian both confirm the advance.

And that's the mews.
